name: getAccess
title: Getaccess
description: Lists the access rights of one or more projects, named by the repeated project parameter.

name: getAccounts
title: Getaccounts
description: Queries accounts visible to the caller. The query is given by the query parameter; use limit and start to page and o to request extra fields.

name: getAccountsAccountId
title: Getaccountsaccountid
description: Returns the details of one account as an AccountInfo entity.

name: getAccountsAccountIdActive
title: Getaccountsaccountidactive
description: Checks if an account is active.

name: getAccountsAccountIdAgreements
title: Getaccountsaccountidagreements
description: Gets a list of the user's signed contributor agreements.

name: getAccountsAccountIdAvatar
title: Getaccountsaccountidavatar
description: Retrieves the avatar image of the user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdAvatarChangeUrl
title: Getaccountsaccountidavatarchangeurl
description: Retrieves the URL where the user can change the avatar image.

name: getAccountsAccountIdCapabilities
title: Getaccountsaccountidcapabilities
description: Returns the global capabilities that are enabled for the specified user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdCapabilitiesCapabilityId
title: Getaccountsaccountidcapabilitiescapabilityid
description: Checks if a user has a certain global capability.

name: getAccountsAccountIdDetail
title: Getaccountsaccountiddetail
description: Retrieves the details of an account as an AccountDetailInfo entity.

name: getAccountsAccountIdEmails
title: Getaccountsaccountidemails
description: Returns the email addresses that are configured for the specified user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdEmailsEmailId
title: Getaccountsaccountidemailsemailid
description: Retrieves an email address of a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdExternalIds
title: Getaccountsaccountidexternalids
description: Retrieves the external ids of a user account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdGpgkeys
title: Getaccountsaccountidgpgkeys
description: Returns the GPG keys of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdGpgkeysGpgKeyId
title: Getaccountsaccountidgpgkeysgpgkeyid
description: Retrieves a GPG key of a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdGroups
title: Getaccountsaccountidgroups
description: Lists all groups that contain the specified user as a member.

name: getAccountsAccountIdName
title: Getaccountsaccountidname
description: Retrieves the full name of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdOauthtoken
title: Getaccountsaccountidoauthtoken
description: Returns a previously obtained OAuth access token.

name: getAccountsAccountIdPreferences
title: Getaccountsaccountidpreferences
description: Retrieves the user's preferences.

name: getAccountsAccountIdPreferencesDiff
title: Getaccountsaccountidpreferencesdiff
description: Retrieves the diff preferences of a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdPreferencesEdit
title: Getaccountsaccountidpreferencesedit
description: Retrieves the edit preferences of a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdSshkeys
title: Getaccountsaccountidsshkeys
description: Returns the SSH keys of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdSshkeysSshKeyId
title: Getaccountsaccountidsshkeyssshkeyid
description: Retrieves an SSH key of a user.

name: getAccountsAccountIdStarredChanges
title: Getaccountsaccountidstarredchanges
description: Gets the changes that were starred with the default star by the identified user account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdState
title: Getaccountsaccountidstate
description: Retrieves the superset of all information related to an account. This information is useful to inspect issues with the account and its permissions. The account state is returned as an AccountStateInfo entity.

name: getAccountsAccountIdStatus
title: Getaccountsaccountidstatus
description: Retrieves the status of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdTokens
title: Getaccountsaccountidtokens
description: Lists the token ids of an account as a list of AuthTokenInfos. The plain text token will never be returned.

name: getAccountsAccountIdUsername
title: Getaccountsaccountidusername
description: Retrieves the username of an account.

name: getAccountsAccountIdWatchedProjects
title: Getaccountsaccountidwatchedprojects
description: Retrieves all projects a user is watching.

name: getChanges
title: Getchanges
description: Queries changes visible to the caller. The query is given by the repeatable query parameter; use limit/start to page and o to request extra fields.

name: getChangesChangeId
title: Getchangeschangeid
description: Retrieves a single change as a ChangeInfo entity; request additional data with the o parameter.

name: getChangesChangeIdAttention
title: Getchangeschangeidattention
description: Returns all users that are currently in the attention set. As response a list of AttentionSetInfo entity is returned.

name: getChangesChangeIdCheck
title: Getchangeschangeidcheck
description: Performs consistency checks on the change, and returns a ChangeInfo entity with the problems field set to a list of ProblemInfo entities.

name: getChangesChangeIdComments
title: Getchangeschangeidcomments
description: Lists the published comments of all revisions of a change, grouped by file path.

name: getChangesChangeIdCustomKeyedValues
title: Getchangeschangeidcustomkeyedvalues
description: Gets the custom keyed values associated with a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdDetail
title: Getchangeschangeiddetail
description: Retrieves a change with labels, detailed labels, detailed accounts, reviewer updates, and messages.

name: getChangesChangeIdDrafts
title: Getchangeschangeiddrafts
description: Lists the draft comments of all revisions of the change that belong to the calling user.

name: getChangesChangeIdEdit
title: Getchangeschangeidedit
description: Retrieves the change edit of the calling user, if one exists, as an EditInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdEditChangeEditId
title: Getchangeschangeideditchangeeditid
description: Retrieves content of a file from a change edit.

name: getChangesChangeIdEditChangeEditIdMeta
title: Getchangeschangeideditchangeeditidmeta
description: Retrieves meta data of a file from a change edit. Currently only web links are returned.

name: getChangesChangeIdEditMessage
title: Getchangeschangeideditmessage
description: Retrieves commit message from change edit.

name: getChangesChangeIdFlows
title: Getchangeschangeidflows
description: Lists the flows of a change that are visible to the caller.

name: getChangesChangeIdFlowsActions
title: Getchangeschangeidflowsactions
description: Lists the flows actions that are configured for the given change.

name: getChangesChangeIdFlowsFlowId
title: Getchangeschangeidflowsflowid
description: Gets a flow on the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdHashtags
title: Getchangeschangeidhashtags
description: Gets the hashtags associated with a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdIn
title: Getchangeschangeidin
description: Retrieves the branches and tags in which a change is included. As result an IncludedInInfo entity is returned.

name: getChangesChangeIdIsFlowsEnabled
title: Getchangeschangeidisflowsenabled
description: Returns whether flows are enabled for this change.

name: getChangesChangeIdMessage
title: Getchangeschangeidmessage
description: Returns the commit message of the change (from the current patch set).

name: getChangesChangeIdMessages
title: Getchangeschangeidmessages
description: Lists the messages of a change as ChangeMessageInfo entities.

name: getChangesChangeIdMessagesChangeMessageId
title: Getchangeschangeidmessageschangemessageid
description: As response a ChangeMessageInfo entity is returned.

name: getChangesChangeIdMetaDiff
title: Getchangeschangeidmetadiff
description: Retrieves the difference between two historical states of a change by specifying the old=SHA-1 and the meta=SHA-1 parameters.

name: getChangesChangeIdPureRevert
title: Getchangeschangeidpurerevert
description: Check if the given change is a pure revert of the change it references in revertOf. Optionally, the query parameter o can be passed in to specify a commit (SHA-1 in 40 digit hex representation) to check against. It takes precedence over revertOf. If the change has no reference in revertOf, the parameter is mandatory.

name: getChangesChangeIdQuery
title: Getchangeschangeidquery
description: Evaluates whether the given change query expression matches the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdReviewers
title: Getchangeschangeidreviewers
description: Lists the reviewers of a change as ReviewerInfo entities.

name: getChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerId
title: Getchangeschangeidreviewersreviewerid
description: Retrieves a reviewer of a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdReviewersReviewerIdVotes
title: Getchangeschangeidreviewersrevieweridvotes
description: Lists the votes for a specific reviewer of the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionId
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionid
description: Retrieves a revision of a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdActions
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidactions
description: Retrieves revision actions of the revision of a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdArchive
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidarchive
description: Retrieves an archive of the files in a revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdComments
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidcomments
description: Lists the published comments of a revision, grouped by file path.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdCommentsCommentId
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidcommentscommentid
description: Retrieves a published comment of a revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdCommit
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidcommit
description: Retrieves the commit of a revision as a CommitInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdDescription
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisioniddescription
description: Retrieves the description of a patch set.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdDrafts
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisioniddrafts
description: Lists the draft comments of the calling user on a revision, grouped by file path.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdDraftsDraftCommentI
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisioniddraftsdraftcommenti
description: Retrieves a draft comment of a revision that belongs to the calling user.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdFiles
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidfiles
description: Lists the files that were added, modified, or deleted in a revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdFilesFileIdBlame
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidfilesfileidblame
description: Gets the blame of a file from a certain revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdFilesFileIdContent
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidfilesfileidcontent
description: Gets the content of a file from a certain revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdFilesFileIdDiff
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidfilesfileiddiff
description: Gets the diff of a file from a certain revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdFilesFileIdDownload
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidfilesfileiddownload
description: Downloads the content of a file from a certain revision, in a safe format that poses no risk for inadvertent execution of untrusted code.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdFixesFixIdPreview
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidfixesfixidpreview
description: Gets the diffs of all files for a certain \{fix-id\}. As response, a map of DiffInfo entities is returned that describes the diffs.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdMergeable
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidmergeable
description: Returns whether a revision can be merged into the destination branch as a MergeableInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdMergelist
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidmergelist
description: Returns the list of commits that are being integrated into a target branch by a merge commit. By default the first parent is assumed to be uninteresting. By using the parent option another parent can be set as uninteresting (parents are 1-based).

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdPatch
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidpatch
description: Returns the formatted patch of a revision (base64-encoded unless the raw content type is requested).

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdPortedComments
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidportedcomments
description: Ports comments of other revisions to the requested revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdPortedDrafts
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidporteddrafts
description: Ports draft comments of other revisions to the requested revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdRelated
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidrelated
description: Lists the changes related to a revision by ancestry as a RelatedChangesInfo entity.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdReview
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidreview
description: Retrieves a change with the review-relevant fields (labels, messages) for a revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdReviewers
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidreviewers
description: Lists the reviewers of a revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdReviewersReviewerId
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidreviewersreviewerid
description: Retrieves a reviewer of a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdReviewersReviewerId_2
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidreviewersreviewerid 2
description: Lists the votes for a specific reviewer of the revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdRobotcomments
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidrobotcomments
description: Lists the robot comments of a revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdRobotcommentsRobotC
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidrobotcommentsrobotc
description: Retrieves a robot comment of a revision.

name: getChangesChangeIdRevisionsRevisionIdSubmitType
title: Getchangeschangeidrevisionsrevisionidsubmittype
description: Gets the method the server will use to submit (merge) the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdRobotcomments
title: Getchangeschangeidrobotcomments
description: Lists the robot comments of all revisions of the change.

name: getChangesChangeIdSubmittedTogether
title: Getchangeschangeidsubmittedtogether
description: Computes list of all changes which are submitted when Submit is called for this change, including the current change itself.

name: getChangesChangeIdSuggestReviewers
title: Getchangeschangeidsuggestreviewers
description: Suggest the reviewers for a given query q and result limit n. If result limit is not passed, then the default 10 is used.

name: getChangesChangeIdTopic
title: Getchangeschangeidtopic
description: Retrieves the topic of a change.

name: getChangesChangeIdValidationOptions
title: Getchangeschangeidvalidationoptions
description: Retrieves the validation options that apply to the change.

name: getConfigServerCaches
title: Getconfigservercaches
description: Lists the caches of the server. Caches defined by plugins are included.

name: getConfigServerCachesCacheId
title: Getconfigservercachescacheid
description: Retrieves information about a cache.

name: getConfigServerCapabilities
title: Getconfigservercapabilities
description: Lists the capabilities that are available in the system. There are two kinds of capabilities: core and plugin-owned capabilities.

name: getConfigServerExperiments
title: Getconfigserverexperiments
description: Lists the experiments that are available in the system.

name: getConfigServerExperimentsExperimentId
title: Getconfigserverexperimentsexperimentid
description: Retrieves the details of the experiment with the given name.

name: getConfigServerIndexes
title: Getconfigserverindexes
description: Lists the indexes used by Gerrit. It provides details about the index versions, which index version is used to search and which versions are written to.

name: getConfigServerIndexesIndexId
title: Getconfigserverindexesindexid
description: Get an index used by Gerrit. It provides details about the index versions, which index version is used to search and which versions are written to.

name: getConfigServerIndexesIndexIdVersions
title: Getconfigserverindexesindexidversions
description: Lists versions of an index used by Gerrit.

name: getConfigServerIndexesIndexIdVersionsIndexVersionId
title: Getconfigserverindexesindexidversionsindexversionid
description: Get info about one version of an index used by Gerrit.

name: getConfigServerInfo
title: Getconfigserverinfo
description: Returns the public configuration of the Gerrit server as a ServerInfo entity.

name: getConfigServerLabels
title: Getconfigserverlabels
description: Lists the globally defined labels (labels that are added programmatically via the LabelType extension point).

name: getConfigServerMetrics
title: Getconfigservermetrics
description: Lists the metrics of the server, returning a map of metric name to a MetricInfo entity.

name: getConfigServerMetricsMetricId
title: Getconfigservermetricsmetricid
description: Retrieves a single metric of the server. The metric name is used as the \{metric-id\} and must be URL-encoded because it may contain slashes.

name: getConfigServerPreferences
title: Getconfigserverpreferences
description: Returns the default user preferences for the server.

name: getConfigServerPreferencesDiff
title: Getconfigserverpreferencesdiff
description: Returns the default diff preferences for the server.

name: getConfigServerPreferencesEdit
title: Getconfigserverpreferencesedit
description: Returns the default edit preferences for the server.

name: getConfigServerSubmitRequirements
title: Getconfigserversubmitrequirements
description: Lists the globally defined submit requirements (submit requirements that are added programmatically via the SubmitRequirement extension point).

name: getConfigServerSummary
title: Getconfigserversummary
description: Retrieves a summary of the current server state.

name: getConfigServerTasks
title: Getconfigservertasks
description: Lists the tasks from the background work queues that the Gerrit daemon is currently performing, or will perform in the near future.

name: getConfigServerTasksTaskId
title: Getconfigservertaskstaskid
description: Retrieves a task from the background work queue that the Gerrit daemon is currently performing, or will perform in the near future.

name: getConfigServerTopMenus
title: Getconfigservertopmenus
description: Returns the list of additional top menu entries.

name: getConfigServerVersion
title: Getconfigserverversion
description: Returns the version of the Gerrit server.

name: getGroups
title: Getgroups
description: Lists the internal groups visible to the caller.

name: getGroupsGroupId
title: Getgroupsgroupid
description: Retrieves a single group as a GroupInfo entity.

name: getGroupsGroupIdDescription
title: Getgroupsgroupiddescription
description: Retrieves the description of a group.

name: getGroupsGroupIdDetail
title: Getgroupsgroupiddetail
description: Retrieves a group with the direct members and the directly included groups.

name: getGroupsGroupIdGroups
title: Getgroupsgroupidgroups
description: Lists the direct subgroups of a group.

name: getGroupsGroupIdGroupsSubgroupId
title: Getgroupsgroupidgroupssubgroupid
description: Retrieves a subgroup.

name: getGroupsGroupIdLogAudit
title: Getgroupsgroupidlogaudit
description: Gets the audit log of a Gerrit internal group.

name: getGroupsGroupIdMembers
title: Getgroupsgroupidmembers
description: Lists the direct members of a Gerrit internal group.

name: getGroupsGroupIdMembersMemberId
title: Getgroupsgroupidmembersmemberid
description: Retrieves a group member.

name: getGroupsGroupIdName
title: Getgroupsgroupidname
description: Retrieves the name of a group.

name: getGroupsGroupIdOptions
title: Getgroupsgroupidoptions
description: Retrieves the options of a group.

name: getGroupsGroupIdOwner
title: Getgroupsgroupidowner
description: Retrieves the owner group of a Gerrit internal group.

name: getPlugins
title: Getplugins
description: Lists the plugins installed on the Gerrit server. Only the enabled plugins are returned unless the all option is specified.

name: getPluginsPluginIdGerritStatus
title: Getpluginspluginidgerritstatus
description: Retrieves the status of a plugin on the Gerrit server.

name: getProjects
title: Getprojects
description: Lists the projects accessible by the caller, optionally filtered by prefix, regex, or substring.

name: getProjectsProjectId
title: Getprojectsprojectid
description: Retrieves a single project as a ProjectInfo entity.

name: getProjectsProjectIdHEAD
title: Getprojectsprojectidhead
description: Retrieves for a project the name of the branch to which HEAD points.

name: getProjectsProjectIdAccess
title: Getprojectsprojectidaccess
description: Lists the access rights for a single project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranches
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranches
description: Lists the branches of a project as BranchInfo entities.

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranchesBranchId
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranchesbranchid
description: Retrieves a branch of a project. For the "All-Users" repository, the magic branch "refs/users/self" is automatically resolved to the user branch of the calling user.

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranchesBranchIdFilesFileIdContent
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranchesbranchidfilesfileidcontent
description: Gets the content of a file from the HEAD revision of a certain branch.

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranchesBranchIdFilesFileIdDiff
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranchesbranchidfilesfileiddiff
description: Gets the diff for a single file between two commits. The base query parameter is required (same as Diff Between Commits).

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranchesBranchIdMergeable
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranchesbranchidmergeable
description: Gets whether the source is mergeable with the target branch.

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranchesBranchIdReflog
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranchesbranchidreflog
description: Gets the reflog of a certain branch.

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranchesBranchIdSuggestReviewers
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranchesbranchidsuggestreviewers
description: Suggest the reviewers for a given query q and result limit n. If result limit is not passed, then the default 10 is used.

name: getProjectsProjectIdBranchesBranchIdValidationOptions
title: Getprojectsprojectidbranchesbranchidvalidationoptions
description: Retrieves the validation options applicable for the given project and branch.

name: getProjectsProjectIdCheckAccess
title: Getprojectsprojectidcheckaccess
description: This command runs access checks for other users. This requires the View Access global capability.

name: getProjectsProjectIdChildren
title: Getprojectsprojectidchildren
description: List the direct child projects of a project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdChildrenChildProjectId
title: Getprojectsprojectidchildrenchildprojectid
description: Retrieves a child project. If a non-direct child project should be retrieved the parameter recursive must be set.

name: getProjectsProjectIdCommitsCommitId
title: Getprojectsprojectidcommitscommitid
description: Retrieves a commit of a project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdCommitsCommitIdDiff
title: Getprojectsprojectidcommitscommitiddiff
description: Lists the files that differ between two commits. This is useful for comparing commits across multiple changes (similar to a pull request diff).

name: getProjectsProjectIdCommitsCommitIdFiles
title: Getprojectsprojectidcommitscommitidfiles
description: Lists the files that were modified, added or deleted in a commit.

name: getProjectsProjectIdCommitsCommitIdFilesFileIdContent
title: Getprojectsprojectidcommitscommitidfilesfileidcontent
description: Gets the content of a file from a certain commit.

name: getProjectsProjectIdCommitsCommitIdFilesFileIdDiff
title: Getprojectsprojectidcommitscommitidfilesfileiddiff
description: Gets the diff for a single file between two commits. The base query parameter is required (same as Diff Between Commits).

name: getProjectsProjectIdCommitsCommitIdIn
title: Getprojectsprojectidcommitscommitidin
description: Retrieves the branches and tags in which a change is included. As result an IncludedInInfo entity is returned.

name: getProjectsProjectIdCommitsIn
title: Getprojectsprojectidcommitsin
description: Gets refs in which the specified commits were merged into. Returns a map of commits to sets of full ref names.

name: getProjectsProjectIdConfig
title: Getprojectsprojectidconfig
description: Gets some configuration information about a project. Note that this config info is not simply the contents of project.config; it generally contains fields that may have been inherited from parent projects.

name: getProjectsProjectIdDashboards
title: Getprojectsprojectiddashboards
description: List custom dashboards for a project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdDashboardsDashboardId
title: Getprojectsprojectiddashboardsdashboardid
description: Retrieves a project dashboard. The dashboard can be defined on that project or be inherited from a parent project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdDescription
title: Getprojectsprojectiddescription
description: Retrieves the description of a project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdLabels
title: Getprojectsprojectidlabels
description: Lists the labels that are defined in this project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdLabelsLabelId
title: Getprojectsprojectidlabelslabelid
description: Retrieves the definition of a label that is defined in this project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdParent
title: Getprojectsprojectidparent
description: Retrieves the name of a project's parent project. For the All-Projects root project an empty string is returned.

name: getProjectsProjectIdStatisticsGit
title: Getprojectsprojectidstatisticsgit
description: Return statistics for the repository of a project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdSubmitRequirements
title: Getprojectsprojectidsubmitrequirements
description: Retrieves a list of all submit requirements for this project. The inherited parameter can be supplied to also list submit requirements from parent projects.

name: getProjectsProjectIdSubmitRequirementsSubmitRequirementI
title: Getprojectsprojectidsubmitrequirementssubmitrequirementi
description: Retrieves the definition of a submit requirement that is defined in this project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdSubmitRequirementsTemplates
title: Getprojectsprojectidsubmitrequirementstemplates
description: Retrieves submit requirement templates configured in project.config and in its parent projects.

name: getProjectsProjectIdSubmitRequirementsTemplatesSubmitReq
title: Getprojectsprojectidsubmitrequirementstemplatessubmitreq
description: Retrieves a single effective submit requirement template for a project. The returned template may be defined in the project itself or inherited from one of its parent projects.

name: getProjectsProjectIdTags
title: Getprojectsprojectidtags
description: List the tags of a project.

name: getProjectsProjectIdTagsTagId
title: Getprojectsprojectidtagstagid
description: Retrieves a tag of a project.
